chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: Dropping in on the Hoofers Club
summary: He stopped by the Hoofers Club only occasionally and did his dancing downtown rather than uptown.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well, that's another place that they had gone. That was next to the Lafayette, I think it was.
Yeah, I suppose you'd go out there to the back with the pool hall in the front.
Did you ever stop by there much?
Oh, once in a while, nothing to brag about, just when I felt like it, you know. Stopped by to see what they

were doing. They never do anything for me. I did all mine downtown, because they knew everybody. If I ain't got nothing to show them, do my dance uptown, no. I keep my dance downtown where I could do it myself, nobody had to do my dance for me up there.
